videos.title: Auth0 in 100 Seconds // And beyond with a Next.js Authentication Tutorial
videos.description: This video explains Auth0, an Authentication-as-a-Service platform. It demonstrates integrating Auth0 for user management within an application, specifically featuring a Next.js authentication tutorial.

videos.title: Next.js 13 - The Basics
videos.description: This tutorial demonstrates Next.js 13 features by building a CRUD application from scratch. It covers frontend development with Next.js and integrates a PocketBase SQL database for backend operations.

videos.title: Next.js Tutorial for Beginners | Next.js 13

videos.title: Next.js Tutorial #10 - Fetching Data (getStaticProps)
videos.description: This video covers data fetching in Next.js using `getStaticProps`. It demonstrates how to integrate fetched data into page components within a Next.js application, focusing on server-side data retrieval for static site generation.

videos.title: Next.js 13 Crash Course Tutorial #1 - Introduction & New Features
videos.description: This tutorial introduces Next.js 13, demonstrating how to build a basic project. It covers core concepts like the new App Router and Server Components, providing a foundational understanding of these updated features.

videos.title: Next.js Tutorial - 3 - Project Structure
videos.description: This video details the fundamental project structure of a Next.js application. It covers how files and directories are organized within a Next.js project, which is essential for understanding and managing development workflows with the framework.

videos.title: Next.js 14 Tutorial - 9 - Catch all Segments
videos.description: This video covers Next.js 14, detailing the implementation and usage of catch-all segments. It explains how to handle dynamic routes that capture multiple path segments, essential for flexible routing within Next.js applications.

videos.title: Next.js Tutorial - 7 - Dynamic Routes
videos.description: This video tutorial explains how to implement dynamic routes in Next.js. It covers the creation and utilization of dynamic paths within the Next.js framework for building web applications.

videos.title: Master Next JS in easy way
videos.description: This video covers fundamental Next.js concepts, including installation, file structure, routing (static and dynamic), layouts, fonts, metadata, server and client components, and API route handlers.

videos.title: Next.js App Router: Routing, Data Fetching, Caching
videos.description: This video explains Next.js app router concepts including layouts, dynamic routes, and data fetching. It covers core foundations, specifically focusing on routing, data fetching mechanisms, caching strategies, and metadata handling within the framework.

videos.title: Using Forms in Next.js (Server Actions, Revalidating Data)
videos.description: This video covers building forms in the Next.js App Router, demonstrating Server Actions, useFormStatus, and useFormState for handling data mutations, loading, and error states. It also addresses data revalidation, caching, and accessibility best practices.
